bootstrap_comment: fields/cache_scan_entries_* carry BOOTSTRAP ceilings at 4x an M3 Max reading. READ THESE AS TREND VISIBILITY, NOT AS A COMPLEXITY GATE: the linear scans are only about 7% of each reading, so a scan regression must be enormous before a ceiling this loose trips, and one scan going quadratic at 128 entries would still pass. The paired sentinel run, whose effect floor is 8% of the reading rather than a multiple of it, is what actually watches this pair -- fields/cache_scan_entries_128 is registered in bench/sentinels.json for that reason. Recalibrate the ceilings with the family.
